units.source_text: 且说桐壶院的病，到了十月里沉重起来。

en.t: Now Kiritsubo-in's illness grew serious in the tenth month.
All the people and officials in the realm were deeply concerned.

units.source_text: 朱雀帝也很担忧，便行幸慰问。

en.t: Emperor Suzaku was also very worried, and went in person to visit and offer comfort.

units.source_text: 桐壶院御体已很衰弱，然而还是反复叮嘱他好好照拂皇太子。

en.t: Kiritsubo-in's body was already very weak, yet he still repeatedly urged him to take good care of the Crown Prince.

units.source_text: 其次提到源氏大将，他说：“我死之后，你须照我在世时一样，事无大小，都同他商量。

en.t: Next he spoke of General Genji, saying, "After I die, just as when I was alive, you must consult him on every matter, great or small.

units.source_text: 此子年龄虽不大，而老成持重，颇能胜任政治。

en.t: Though he is still young, he is mature and prudent, and is quite capable of handling affairs of state.

units.source_text: 看他的相貌，确是治国平天下之才。

en.t: Judging from his bearing, he truly has the talent to govern the country and bring peace to the realm.

units.source_text: 因此，我为避免诸亲王妒忌，特地不封他为亲王，将他降为臣下，而使他当朝廷的后援人。

en.t: For this reason, to avoid the jealousy of the other princes, I deliberately did not make him an imperial prince, but lowered him to the rank of a subject so that he could serve as a support for the court.

units.source_text: 你不可辜负我这一片苦心。”

en.t: You must not fail to honor this painstaking intention of mine."
Besides these, he left many other sorrowful final words.

units.source_text: 作者乃一女流，不宜高谈国事。

en.t: The author is only a woman, and it is not fitting for her to speak loftily about affairs of state.

units.source_text: 记此一端，亦不免越俎之罪。

en.t: Even recording this single matter cannot avoid the fault of overstepping one's proper place.
